work.description: Mixed-media collage on black ground incorporating multiple compact discs—including a pink Verbatim CD-R and several silver-toned discs—overlaid with line-drawn warplane diagrams, a wooden chess king piece, yellow target stickers, iridescent foil fragments, and beaded cord arranged across layered transparent and reflective surfaces.
work.title: Squadron with Pink Vinyl
